issues.email_excerpt: Our team will extend the coupon's expiry date tomorrow.
issues.explanation: Extending the expiry is the customer's own planned step (I5, that evening), presented as a support commitment with a changed time.
Support's "by tomorrow" was relative to the call date (2026-10-30); "tomorrow" in an email read later is not anchored and shifts the deadline.
